title: Bound on summed third absolute moments
statement: Let $\\iota$ be a finite index set, let $(\\Omega,\\mu)$ be a probability space, and let $X_i:\\Omega\\to\\mathbb R$ be square-integrable random variables with mean zero for each $i\\in\\iota$. Suppose their variances sum to $1$, and for some $\\varepsilon\\in\\mathbb R$, each satisfies $|X_i|\\le\\varepsilon$ almost everywhere. Then $\\sum_{i\\in\\iota}\\int_\\Omega |X_i|^3\\,d\\mu\\le\\varepsilon$.�
hypotheses_covered: There exists $\\varepsilon\\in\\mathbb R$ such that $|X_i|\\le\\varepsilon$ almost everywhere for every $i$
